## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (2)
- `GET /platform/auth/_/config` — Get authentication configuration for the Supabase platform.
- `GET /ruleSet/{ruleSetToken}` — Retrieve a rule set using its token for authentication.

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /aggregate/en` — Get aggregated data for the English language.
- `GET /dashboard/api/get-deployment-commit` — Get the commit hash of the current Supabase deployment.
- `GET /translations/translations-en.json` — Download the English translation file.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /consent/uw/3` — Submit consent data for a specific user.

### Config (2)
- `GET /platform/projects/_/config/storage` — Get storage configuration for a Supabase project.
- `GET /settings/650dpbAjfyAypn/latest/{latestId}` — Retrieve the latest settings configuration.
